name: leancomplete
description: Minimal inline autocomplete. No chat panel, no telemetry, just ghost-text completions.

leanComplete.endpoint.description: FIM completion endpoint. Use https://api.mistral.ai/v1/fim/completions if your key is a regular La Plateforme key rather than a dedicated Codestral key.

leanComplete.model.description: Codestral model id to use for FIM completions.

enumDescriptions: Single-line whenever there's real content after the cursor on the current line; multi-line only when the rest of the line is blank.
Always stop at the first newline — fastest, lowest-risk suggestions.
Allow multi-line blocks whenever the rest of the line is blank (still forced to single-line if that's not the case, to avoid splitting existing code).
leanComplete.completionMode.description: Controls whether completions can span multiple lines. 'auto' is recommended — it's also what makes suggestions faster on average, since single-line requests are cheaper to generate.

leanComplete.singleLineMaxTokens.description: Token ceiling for single-line completions. Kept low for speed — the model also hard-stops at the first newline regardless of this cap.

leanComplete.multiLineMaxTokens.description: Token ceiling for multi-line completions. (Previously called maxTokens; lowered from 256 by default to cut worst-case latency — raise it back if you want longer block completions.)

leanComplete.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0 = deterministic, most predictable completions.

leanComplete.maxPrefixLines.description: How many lines before the cursor to send as context. Lowered from 100 — trims prompt size for faster responses; raise it if completions start missing relevant context.

leanComplete.maxSuffixLines.description: How many lines after the cursor to send as context. Lowered from 40 for the same reason as maxPrefixLines.

leanComplete.debounceMs.description: Default wait after you stop typing before requesting a completion. Overridden by triggerCharacterDebounceMs right after a trigger character. Skipped entirely on a cache hit.

leanComplete.triggerCharacters.description: Characters that, when just typed, use triggerCharacterDebounceMs instead of the normal debounceMs — these are moments you're usually pausing specifically to see a suggestion (member access, a call, an assignment...).

leanComplete.triggerCharacterDebounceMs.description: Debounce used right after typing a trigger character. Kept short but non-zero so rapid keystroke combos don't fire a flood of requests.

leanComplete.requestTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for a single request before it's aborted and (if retries remain) retried.

leanComplete.maxRetries.description: Retry attempts for timeouts, network errors, or 5xx responses, with exponential backoff. 429s are handled separately via a cooldown, not retried.

leanComplete.cooldownMs.description: Fallback pause after a 429 (rate limit) response if the API doesn't send a Retry-After header.

leanComplete.numSuggestions.description: How many alternative completions to fetch, cycle through with Alt+] / Alt+[. Each extra suggestion is a separate parallel API call, so raising this multiplies request volume and cost.

leanComplete.disabledLanguages.description: Language ids where suggestions are always skipped.

leanComplete.cacheEnabled.description: Reuse the last completion(s) for an identical prefix/suffix/mode combo (e.g. after undo/redo, or retyping) instead of calling the API again.
